title: OKR-aligned model prioritization and release ripple planning for Hosted API
creator: Sonia Patel
description: Objective: produce an operationalized process that maps quarterly OKRs to a prioritized set of model onboarding/rotation actions and computes the downstream release 'ripple' across hosted endpoints. This ticket defines the framework, acceptance gates, simulation plan, and stakeholder signoff flow so product, engineering, and platform teams can schedule coordinated releases with measurable rollback and cost/quality tradeoffs.
acceptance_criteria: Prioritization rubric documented: OKR alignment, latency/cost delta, customer cohort exposure, and regression risk scoring
Automated dependency graph generated for the model catalog showing affected hosted endpoints and traffic share estimates
Release ripple plan template (canary windows, staggered rollout, fallback model mapping) vetted by ENG and DX
Two dry-run simulations completed using traffic replay (one low-risk, one high-risk) with post-mortem and metric baselines
Stakeholder signoff checklist implemented in the release template and linked in the console rollout workflow
milestones: Week 1: Build prioritization rubric and scoring matrix
Week 2: Instrument dependency export from model catalog and hosted endpoints
Week 3: Implement release ripple template and rollout checklist in Confluence
Week 4: Run low-risk traffic replay simulation and iterate on gates
Week 6: Run high-risk simulation, collect metrics, finalize playbook
Week 8: Handoff for Q2 operational use and training session for SRE/SEs
risks: Incomplete dependency mapping may lead to missed endpoints and customer regressions
Traffic replay fidelity limited for rare edge prompts impacting regression detection
Canary windows not aligned with customer SLAs for enterprise tenants
Cost estimates for staggered rollouts might exceed budget if quantization/variants differ
stakeholders: Nina Cho (Eng - Runtime) - dependency graph and simulation hooks
Diego Morales (SRE) - rollout gating and canary orchestration
